text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The history and future of<n>Umamusume. And the
present. To<n>think I'd be in such an article.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look. Your name's here too,<n>Trainer. Well, of
course it is, since<n>you've been with me from the
start.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of statistics in here as<n>well. Not that I
really have the head<n>for them—I just run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to this magazine, it'll be<n>like everyone
from my hometown can<n>have me right next to them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll have to do even better. I<n>want to make it
into a lot more<n>articles.
